Follow-up began 7 days after the first dispensing and stopped at psychosis, 60 days after the end of supply, a switch to the other stimulant, death, end of enrolment or 31 December 2016. Outcome: a new diagnosis code for psychosis with an antipsychotic prescription the same day or within 60 days (positive predictive value 93.1% in an outside health-record validation; 91.3% in a review of claims profiles by a psychiatrist unaware of the drug, with 10.1% and 8.4% of cases judged unlikely to be true psychosis). Primary analysis: 1:1 propensity-score matching within each database on all prespecified covariates (year, age, sex, region, insurance, markers of ADHD severity, other psychiatric disorders and medicines, substance use disorders, prescriber type, use of care), Cox models, pooled by fixed-effect meta-analysis; at least 80% power for a 50% higher risk.
